report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the alert: gateway, order, and payment all show error_rate 0.0012, p95 71ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; gateway logs show status 200 request_complete. Order shows 300MB retained after GC with 8000 net allocations, but no memory-retention history exists, so a leak cannot be claimed. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; handoff required.
missing_evidence: Time-series memory-retention history for order to distinguish a leak from a steady baseline
Evidence of actual elevated error rate or latency matching the alert window
Dependency timeout or db pool waiter data showing saturation
Deployment facts for the alert window to assess version-related latency
